rca of the issue: RCA-1 (runtime blockage): OpenNext preview depends on Wrangler 4.125 which hard-requires Node >=22; container currently exposes Node 20.20.2, so local worker cannot boot for runtime E2E. RCA-2 (header parity risk): SiteHeader closes menus only through explicit `onNavigate` callbacks but lacks pathname-change reset, so in persistent layout navigation paths not using `onNavigate` can retain open state across route transitions. RCA-3 (route parity risk): Next navigation-data is trimmed compared with CRA menu datasets, risking missing route exposure unless this reduction is intentional product scope.
